description: Synthetic personas attempt defined tasks on a UI, scored turn by turn on friction, confusion, and task completion. Best for identifying where users get stuck, abandon, or succeed in completing a specific flow.

eval_metrics.description: Did the persona reach the defined success condition?
Aggregate friction signals per turn (0 = completely smooth, 10 = fully blocked)
Moments of stated uncertainty or misdirected action
Expressions of trust or distrust toward the product or process
What caused the persona to exit the task early
How well persona behaviour reflects the defined persona traits

eval_schema.persona_instructions: At each turn, navigate the UI as this persona would. Report: what action you take, which screen or element you are on, your inner monologue, friction score (0-10), any confusion or trust signal, and whether the task is in_progress / completed / abandoned. If abandoned, state the trigger.

planner_guidance: Focus the plan on task completion and friction identification. Define a clear success condition and abandon condition for every task. Identify the exact UI steps where drop-off is most likely. The primary metric is task completion rate. Hypotheses should predict where friction will occur and why.

report_sections.hypothesis_focus: Predict where friction will occur in the task flow and whether the design enables task completion without external assistance.
